title: Gradio turns multi-step AI pipelines into visible, deployable workflow graphs
friendlyTitle: Gradio makes AI workflows easier to see and test
summary: The new gr.Workflow interface represents Python functions, hosted models, Spaces, and datasets as typed graph nodes on a drag-and-drop canvas. Each node and intermediate output can be inspected, while the same workflow is exposed as REST endpoints and can be deployed to Hugging Face Spaces.
friendlySummary: You can connect AI models and Python steps on a visual canvas, run each step, and see the result. The workflow also becomes an API and can be deployed online.
whyItMatters: Visible intermediate steps make multi-model pipelines easier to debug, demonstrate, and hand to non-specialists. Developers can prototype media, data, or model workflows in one interface without giving up callable APIs or custom Python code.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This can make complex AI apps easier to build, explain, and fix when one step goes wrong.
